one_liner: Devin is an AI assistant for automating repetitive software engineering tasks including code review and codebase analysis.

auth.notes: Bearer token authentication via Authorization header. Supports Service User API Keys (cog_ prefix) for automation and Personal Access Tokens for human access.

evidence.snippet: Include your token in the Authorization header of every request:
A Service User API Key authenticates as the service user
A Personal Access Token authenticates as the human user who created it

access.notes: Pages document Individual and Teams plans but do not state whether API access is free-tier, paid-only, or requires approval; no explicit mention of free developer credentials.

evidence.snippet: Individual and Teams plans are available.
If your company is already working with Cognition, you can request permissions from your Administrator

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limiting enforced; specific limit values not documented.

evidence.snippet: Learn how to programmatically interact with Devin using our REST APIs
429 Too Many Requests : Rate limit exceeded

buildability.rationale: REST API is well-documented with broad resource coverage and clear bearer-token authentication, but free-tier API credential access is not documented.

overview_evidence.snippet: Devin is most effective when it's part of your team and your existing workflow.
Watch Devin browse through documentation, test web applications it builds, download/upload information.

unknown_reasons.access: Pages document Teams and Enterprise plans but do not specify pricing tier, free-tier eligibility for API access, or sandbox/developer account availability.
unknown_reasons.api_surface: OpenAPI specification not referenced; webhook support not mentioned in provided documentation.
unknown_reasons.mcp: No URL for official vendor-published MCP server documented; only Composio's third-party toolkit referenced.
